title: Dayflow — quick ops & launch log
body:
Morning focus: finish PRD edits for model-pin behavior + compile stakeholder ask list

PRD edits (brief):
- Section: model pinning semantics — add 2 examples (canary -> stable, downgrade fallback) + edge-case table for incompatible quantizations
- Requirements: add SLA note for dedicated customers (latency SLO paragraph)
- UX: clarify console dropdown labeling (Model vs Variant) — Rina to validate copy by 3/14
- TODO: attach short eval result table (latency vs cost) from Diego

Key follow-ups (today):
- Jonas: confirm autoscale policy text and metric names (RW-4321) — need metric thresholds by EOD
- Rina: finalize UX microcopy + screenshot for PRD; add a11y note
- Infra (Diego): verify KV cache warmup plan (linked tests) and failure modes
- Legal: pinged for data residency blurb — no reply yet (reminder noon)

Launch checklist (quick smoke):
- [ ] Canary deploy plan written + rollback steps (sane defaults)
- [ ] Health-check endpoints defined and load tested (qps targets + 95p p99 latency)
- [ ] Monitoring dashboards: token cost, per-route latency, error-rate alerting
- [ ] Fallback routing: ensure model-variant fallback policy present in config
- [ ] Docs snippet: sample client call with pinned model + expected response codes

Risks / open questions:
- Model-variant compatibility: what is our recommended approach when quantized variant fails? (fallback to float32?)
- Cost delta for small vs large tokens under continuous batching — need sample compute. (Diego to run batch profiles)
- Console UX: do we auto-suggest quantization? could be confusing; maybe hide behind "advanced" toggle

Meeting notes (standup 09:10):
- Jonas: Autoscale policy draft v0.2 -> expecting perf numbers tomorrow
- Rina: screenshots in progress, asked for font sizes from Design
- SRE: agree to run 1hr soak test on dedicated pool before canary

Quick wins / low effort items to push today:
- Add example curl to PRD (done)
- Update internal Slack thread with fallback decision (post after lunch)

Notes to self:
- Keep PRD light on implementation detail; link to infra runbook for ops-level steps
- Remember to add rolling window for cost-alert thresholds (not absolute)
- Draft an email for customers in dedicated beta about expected behavior during canary

End of day deliverables:
- PRD updated with examples and UX mocks (target: 3/13 18:00)
- Autoscale metrics confirmed (target: 3/13 17:00)
- Short test plan for KV cache warmup (target: 3/14 noon)

Random snippets / snippets-to-clip:
- Slack refs: #prod-hosted-api, #infra-kv
- Helpful tickets: RW-4330 (canary runbook), RW-4412 (observability dashboard request)

If blocked: escalate to Jonas then to me — prioritize SLA nuances and rollback clarity.

-- Maya
